name: Anoka County Growers Association (Anoka, Blaine, Coon Rapids)
description: Anoka County Growers Association (Anoka, Blaine, Coon Rapids) is a farmers market in 11000 Crooked Lake Blvd NW, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
